profile.headline: Software Engineer at Educational Testing Service (ETS)
profile.summary:
Software developer/tester of software applications in the MS Windows, Linux and UNIX environments.

Specialties: Software development and test execution.

Software developed in Perl, C/C++, Java, Java Script, UNIX shell, MS Visual Basic scripting, PL/I, Fortran, Cobol, Pascal, and Assembler.

Software packages: Selenium, Eclipse, Silk Test, Maven, SAHI, CSS

Triage of test results and root cause analysis of problems.
Development of tools to assist with testing and test system setup.

Development of Microsoft shell scripts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed Java Script and Perl Programs to automate building and testing of iBT tests for CLEP, Georgia, GRE, HiSET, TOEFL, Praxis, and TExES test programs

Implemented Java Script programs to automate candidate profile creation and test registration for the Georgia, GRE, HiSET, Praxis iBT test programs 

Conducted training sessions and published test automation user guides for team members  

Tested and corrected defects for the Georgia Code of Ethics Online training program 

Skills used – Perl, Java Script, JSON, CSS, AJAX, HTML, XML, YAML, SAHI, GitLab

positions.title: Test engineer
positions.description:
- Created award winning system to collect user test requirements, execute and manage pre and post move testing for several thousand pieces of electronic equipment in support of the Fort Monmouth B.R.A.C.

- Gathered, reviewed, and secured sign off of test requirements

- Designed, implemented, and managed MS Access databases to hold pre/post move test results and calibration data

- Managed a team of 6 engineers to execute pre and post move testing and recalibration in Fort Monmouth and APG

positions.title: Software quality assurance engineer
positions.description: Integral part in getting clients addressable advertising release qualified and delivered on schedule by verifying 40 defects, documenting detailed verification steps, filing 20 defects, developing test tools in Perl, and documenting screen differences between the last two releases. This release helped the client land its biggest paying customer.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description: IT professional with extensive experience in the enterprise business and telecommunications industries with expertise in software testing, development, hardware environment configuration with strong project management skills. Supported all aspects of the software development life cycle from startup through maintenance. Virtualization subject matter expert for testing. Consistently recognized for success in managing the qualification of multiple releases simultaneously. Entrepreneur and former business owner. Looking to obtain an employee or contractor position in software testing or development.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
Successfully served as lead test engineer for HP's High Availability solution called Serviceguard (SG) and HP's Integrity Virtual Machines (VM) solution. Created, peer reviewed, published, and executed certification test plans. Coded and executed feature test cases, triaged test failures and filed numerous defects which resulted in finding 97% of all product defects. Instrumental in helping SG achieve an in house defect find rate of 99%.  
Automated manual tests for SG/Integrity VM's guest application monitoring (client/server) solution resulting in the reduction of the feature's test execution schedule by 40%.     
Completed qualification of Compaq's High Availability Cluster solution and several enhancements for Oracle Corporation which allowed the successful rollout of a High Availability Cluster solution for Oracle. 
Researched audio recording software, wrote up guidelines for using Audacity recording software, initiated the recordings of the first several technical presentations, created a repository of MP3 recordings, and influenced our lab to follow the guidelines created. This sparked the adoption of a policy to record technical presentations in our lab. The repository has grown to over 50 recordings thus saving HP thousands of dollars in training. 

Mentored summer intern which allowed her to become productive and fully participate in the testing lifecycle of High Availability/Virtualization and as a result she was hired by HP. 
Served as system administrator, hardware technician, and assisted in lab relocations and setups for test lab machines which saved the business unit approximately $10k in service calls. 
Skills used - Perl, C/C++, Java, UNIX, Linux, Windows, HP Open View, shell scripts, AWK, CFS, IBM Clear Case, VxVM, LVM, and Python.

positions.title: Entrepreneur
positions.description:
Successfully launched startup of franchise business and served as CEO, office and sales manager. 
Increased revenue from $0 to $231K, decreased labor from 49% to 39%, and increased sales close rate from 41% to 52%. 
Grew the business to a staff of 12 employees, over 100 customers and sold the business in 2000.

company.name: The Maids of Greater New Brunswick

positions.title: System analyst, software developer and tester
positions.description:
Successfully served as the lead system analyst for the collection of user requirements for a remote client/server interface between a hand-held telephone technician terminal and the Work and Force Administration Dispatch Out (WFA/DO) system. Created and published the Remote Contract Interface specification enabling Telcordia to win a business contract and produce a competitive product which saved the Regional Bell Operating Companies (RBOCs) $400,000.  
Designed, coded and tested software for the WFA Dispatch Contract Interface and several releases of WFA/DO which allowed the RBOCs to stay ahead of their competition. 
Designed, coded, and executed product test flows for Advanced Service Management Creation Service (ASMS) and participated in the testing of CORE INAP in ISCP (Intelligent Services Control Point) which allowed our customers to roll out popular calling features. 
Mentored two summer interns simultaneously and helped them to actively participate in the software development life cycle and add value to deliverables.  
Developed scripts for an automated telephone menu system that operated using speech processing and recognition. Conducted experiments that proved the viability of speech processing but immaturity of speech recognition technology. The results of the experiments were used as input to a usability design paper published by Dr. Michael Muller. 
Skills used - C/C++, UNIX, Windows, Assembler, PL/I, TCP/IP, and ASN.1.
